Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, mid 30s goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, soft and heavy and slack; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, her waist lost beneath the folds, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long wavy golden blonde hair — her bare skin covered from the neck down in a flat matte slate-black chalkboard body-paint ground covered in big bold chalk X marks and circles in pastel pink, sky blue and butter yellow, a large tic-tac-toe grid centred on her bust and torso in thick white chalk lines, each X and circle about the size of her palm, thick dusty strokes, the print sitting on living skin and following every curve beneath it, covering all of her skin from the neck to the ankles and the backs of her hands, her face left unpainted and the pattern fading out at the neck. The illustration continues over her bare breasts as one painted surface on living skin, wrapping around each curve of the bust and dipping into the cleft between her breasts, following the shadowed line of her cleavage. Her face, ears, neck and hands are real living skin with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs, a soft natural flush. Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy cobalt blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.

Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.

Background: a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind her, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
